QuestInfo.name: Cooperation
QuestInfo.0: #p9110114# seems willing to accept you as an ally. Talk to him and find out what he wants.
QuestInfo.1:
If you want #p9110114#'s help, you'll have to prove you're not one of the bad guys. Take out 200
#b#o9400406##k soldiers and bring 100 of their 
#b#t04000344#s#k to #b#p9110108##k. 

#t04000344# #b#c04000344##k/100#k
#o9400406#  #b#a81681##k

0.0: Sorry I made you wait on me, but my heart was just buuursting with joy to meet you.
0.1: I sent word to my #bBestest Friend in the Foreververse#k to let him know you've arrived just in time to help us!
0.2: He told me not to tell you his name. He must just looove surprises as much as I do.
0.3: Speaking of which, I made you a present while we were standing here! But I thought friends were supposed to EXCHANGE gifts, not just take them... Right?

yes.0: I knew you had the power of friendship in your heart!
yes.1: The only gift I really want is to find out if Gigatoad is up to no good... And the best way to do that is to make him mad!
yes.2: Go get 100 #b#t04000344#s#k from those silly-billy #b#o9400406##k soldiers. You can just take it right over to my good buddy #b#p9110108##k. The best gift is giving to others!

no.0: Oh, don't be such a grouchaloo!

1.0: Fujihawk spied you from afar, and clawed at my arm with excitement. You must be someone special.
1.1: I see you have a big batch of #t04000344#s. Are those an offering to Fujihawk? They are his favorites, after all...
1.2: Fujihawk tells me he smells #p9110114# on you. He's wondering if he ever got the hat Fujihawk wove him for the last cherry blossom festival...
1.3: No matter. We have more important business. Fujihawk spied the Daimyo in his chambers the other day, lounging in a steamy pool of water filled with coins.
1.4: That's why Fujihawk ordered this investigation. \r\n(He and Fujihawk share a knowing look.) \r\nYes, Fujihawk... We WILL get to the bottom of this.

npc.0: Just get 100 #b#t04000344#s#k from those troublesome little #b#o9400406##k soldiers and take them to #b#p9110108##k.
